The letter —, which stands for the sound /ɡ/, in Pitman shorthand.

The presumed language of the Gaya confederacy.
A composition in the Gayatri metre.
The supposed ability to detect whether or not a person is gay by observing that person's appearance, mannerisms, etc.

superlative form of gay: most gay

The state of being gay (homosexual); homosexuality; demeanor stereotypically representative of it.
